title: Free AI agency with 147 specialized agents for business tasks and #AItools #Automation #OpenSource
description:
A new open-source AI agency has been released as a free GitHub repository, offering 147 specialized AI sub-agents arranged to replicate the structure of a real business. These agents are grouped into 12 departments, covering key functions like engineering, marketing, sales, support, finance, and security, each with distinct roles, personalities, and tones to handle specific tasks. For instance, the marketing agent can generate ad copy, while the engineering agent can fix bugs based on user input.

This product insight lies in its comprehensive and modular approach, enabling users to deploy a fully operational AI-driven business environment in one package. It works by running the repository in parallel using platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, maximizing efficiency through coordinated AI agents. The setup appeals to developers and businesses seeking scalable automation across multiple domains without building each AI component individually.

The business value extends to streamlining operations, reducing the need for separate AI tools, and fostering innovation by giving users a versatile and ready-to-use AI workforce. Its open-source nature encourages community-driven improvements and customization, enhancing adaptability and broad application.
